sidebar.helpDescription: Contact a certified financial advisor in real time.

home.welcomeTitle: Welcome to the Vehicle Financial Portal
home.welcomeDescription: Evaluate vehicle loans, analyze technical depreciation, manage vehicle catalog, and perform financial simulations with exact APR rates in real time.
home.catalogDesc: Explore registered units with 3-layer fuzzy search engine.
home.simulationsDesc: Calculate down payment, loan balance, NPV, IRR, and French/German schedule.
home.scoringDesc: Calculate payment capacity and client risk tier (Score from 300 to 850).

iam.signInSubtitle: Enter your credentials to access the portal
iam.signUpSubtitle: Register to access vehicle credit simulations
iam.forgotPasswordSubtitle: Enter your registered email to receive recovery instructions
iam.resetPasswordSubtitle: Enter the recovery token and your new password
iam.passwordHelp: Password must include at least one uppercase letter (e.g. Password123!).
iam.dealerNotice: Note: New accounts are created as buyers. If you are a dealer or bank, you can upgrade your account by verifying your official RUC in your profile.
iam.businessElevationSubtitle: Validate your official RUC with SUNAT to accredit your account as a Dealer or Financial Institution
iam.dealerElevationSubtitle: Validate your official RUC with SUNAT to publish and manage vehicles on the platform
iam.dealerAccreditedDesc: Your account has verified ROLE_DEALER permissions with SUNAT. You can register vehicle units and manage your commercial inventory.
iam.financialAccreditedTitle: Account Enabled with Financial Institution Role
iam.financialAccreditedDesc: Your account has verified ROLE_FINANCIAL_INSTITUTION permissions with SUNAT. You can configure benchmark interest rates and manage financial entities.
iam.sunatRequirementDesc: To acquire the Dealer role, the RUC must exist, be ACTIVE, HABIDO, and registered with automotive economic activity (CIIU 451).
iam.financialSunatRequirementDesc: To acquire the Financial Institution role, the RUC must exist, be ACTIVE, HABIDO, and registered with financial intermediation activity (CIIU 64 or 66).
iam.fillDemoFinancialRucBtn: Fill verified RUC (Banco de Crédito BCP)
iam.rucFormatHint: Enter the official 11-digit RUC of your automotive enterprise.
iam.financialRucFormatHint: Enter the official 11-digit RUC of your banking or financial institution.
iam.requestFinancialBtn: Validate RUC & Upgrade to Financial Institution
iam.dealerRequestSuccess: RUC successfully verified with SUNAT! Your role has been upgraded to Dealer (ROLE_DEALER).
iam.financialRequestSuccess: RUC successfully verified with SUNAT! Your role has been upgraded to Financial Institution (ROLE_FINANCIAL_INSTITUTION).
